limitations: World-only rendering proof; HUD and browser interaction are outside this check.
Ground city membership follows the source-backed completed Town Center query; complete native CityManager registration/priority behavior remains separate.
Only declared AnimatedTextureSetName model parts use source skin lists. The selected static native model atmosphere is proven; native weather RNG/events and time-of-day scheduling remain separate.
Reflection currently reuses the visible main instance set; native separate reflected-view culling and complete RTT/projection policy are not established.
Native water UV scale, normal projection, time-vector population and six-own-class to eight-native-movement mapping remain explicit adapters.
